newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cerestar to raise sugar substitute output.
newsitem.headline: Cerestar to raise sugar substitute output.

text.p: Franco-italian food group Eridania Beghin-Say said on Thursday its Cerestar unit planned to raise production of starch-based sweetener C*Eridex in Europe and in the United states.
The company said in a statement it would upgrade production lines of Cerestar Italy in 1998 to reach a yearly capacity of 10,000 tonnes aimed at the U.S. and Japanese markets.
Cerestar plans to set up new production lines at one of its U.S. starch plants to reach capacity of 30,000 tonnes by 2000.
C*Eridex is produced from crystallised Erythritol, a starch derivative, and is used in non-caloric food products.
